columns.description: Uniquely identifies the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CREATED_DATE
columns.description: Created Date of the Gen AI Document in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: DOCUMENT_PUBLISHED_DATE
columns.description: Published Date of the Gen AI Document in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DELETED_DATE
columns.description: Deleted Date of the Gen AI Document in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: ID of the owner who created the Gen AI Document in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the owner who created the Gen AI Document in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: This column represents the system name of the Document.

columns.name: INTERNAL_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column represents the system description of the Document.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
